description:
FILED s543g (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22) while probing #540's `delete local` shape; PRE-EXISTING (base 8959afae the same).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | PCL):
    our %h = (a => {b => 1}, k => 1); my $c = 0;
    { delete local $h{k} if $c; print exists $h{k} ? "E" : "N" } print "\n";
        perl  E        PCL  N
(s543g worktree scratch/s543g/probes/m1c/c05_delmod.pl.)

WHY (read, not measured): Pl::Stmt::local_delete_shape reads `delete local SYM SUBSCRIPT` off the statement's first tokens and never looks for a trailing modifier; Parser2::_local_plan_delete opens the localizer unconditionally.  The `local` plan's other kinds gate the save/restore with p-local-maybe (ir-spec 7.2, #541) -- the delete kind should take the same test.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `delete local $h{k} if COND` ignores the modifier -- the element is deleted (and restored at the block end) even when COND is false
triage_reason: `delete local ELEM if COND`: the modifier is dropped
